mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 6 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 9, low 6.

Democrats are poised to capture the U.S. House of Representatives in the midterm elections, while the Senate contest remains extremely close, putting control of Congress at stake.

A 53-year-old man died in Bulqizë, Albania, after police say he was attacked and mauled by a lion.

Italian police have detained 21-year-old Eduart Xh, an Albanian resident of Chiari, on suspicion of stabbing his 39-year-old mother, Meleqe L, to death.

U.S. efforts to force lower drug prices could force Swiss pharmaceutical firms to raise prices abroad, potentially costing them hundreds of millions of francs each year.

Manchester United overturned a two-goal deficit to defeat Roma 3-2 at home, completing a dramatic comeback victory.
